saints.name: St. James
saints.title: Apostle
saints.shortBlurb: Son of Zebedee, brother of John, one of the three closest to the Lord and the first Apostle to die for the faith…
biography: James the Greater, a Galilean fisherman and brother of John, was called with him from the nets to follow Christ. With Peter and John he witnessed the Transfiguration and the Agony in the Garden. He was the first of the Twelve to be martyred, beheaded by Herod Agrippa at Jerusalem about the year 44.
The great shrine of Santiago de Compostela in Spain has honored him since the Middle Ages as the goal of one of Christendom's chief pilgrimages.
saints.knownFor: The first Apostle martyred; patron of pilgrims to Compostela.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 25 July
